answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs and are forfeited if peers later show its attestations were collusive. An attacker spinning up 500 fake agents must fund each one's work up front, then wait out the lock while the ledger acts as a beacon exposing correlated behavior. When the tide of audits turns, the whole cluster is slashed, so the attack's expected payoff sinks to its nadir: real costs, zero spendable gain.
